newsitem.title: USA: KEMET to put $72 mln in facilites in 1998.
newsitem.headline: KEMET to put $72 mln in facilites in 1998.

text.p: KEMET Corp said Thursday that it plans to invest about $72 million in fiscal 1998 in its surface mount manufacturing capacity.

The company said it was taking the action to meet growing worldwide demand for its ceramic and tantalum capacitors and will expand its facilities in Ft. Inn, South Carolina, Shelby, North Carolina and Simpsonville, South Carolina.
In addition, KEMET said it plans to invest about $23 million in research and development in fiscal 1998 and aggressively expand its sales network into mainland China.
KEMET is a manufacturer and supplier of solid tantalum capacitors and multilayer ceramic capacitors.
